{{Infobox |eng = Leek |source = [[Foraging]] • [[Spring Seeds]] |season = Spring |sellprice = 60 |edibility = 16 |xp = 7 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] |color = White }} The '''Leek''' is found via [[foraging]] in the [[Spring]], or grown from [[Spring Seeds]]. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Leek per year on [[George]]'s birthday, [[Fall|Fall 24]]. It can randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Spring. Leeks are most common on [[the Mountain]] and [[Backwoods]] maps, where 58% of spring forage items will be Leeks. They can also be found at the [[Bus Stop]] (20%), [[Railroad]] (20%) and the [[Farm Maps#Forest|Forest]] (25%) and [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach]] farms. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |neutral=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Abigail,Alex,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Kent,Marnie,Gus,Sandy |dislike=Sebastian,Pierre,Caroline,Haley,Jas,Leo,Vincent,Jodi,Sam,Shane,Elliott,Dwarf,Wizard,Willy,Krobus |like=Linus,Penny,Leah,Harvey |love=George }} ==Bundles== Leek is used in the {{Bundle|Spring Foraging||y}}. ==Recipes== ===Cooking=== {{Recipes|header|hide=buff,duration}} {{:Salad|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{Recipes|footer}} ===Crafting=== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredients !Recipe Source !Sell Price |- |[[File:Spring Seeds.png|center]] |[[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds (Sp)]] ||{{Description|Spring Seeds}}
